description: Stage 4o dedicated cases: arrow block bodies (`x => { let y = 1; return y; }`) and object literal method bodies (`({ m(){ let y = 2; } })`). Both constructs mount the block body catalog on the body `{` at bracket-creation time (predicate: the previous non-trivia unit is `=>` for arrow bodies; the host bracket has no catalog and the previous unit is a closed `(` or a return-type brace for object methods) and are then built through the SAME collection channel as function bodies: `StatementBuilder.BuildBlock()` -> `HasBuiltBodyStatements` / `CollectBodyStatements`. Each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte; (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML; (4) no StatementShape shell leaks into the shape tree. The takeover counters (`ArrowBodyMountCount` / `FunctionBodyMountCount` / `BlockBodyStatementCount`) and the no-fallback expectation are asserted by tests/statement-possible/s4o-arrow-object.mjs and recorded in HANDOFF-s4o.md. The trap group is the safety gate: type literals, object literals without methods, control-flow bodies, label bodies and switch case blocks must NOT mount a catalog.

stage4o.stage: Stage 4o (arrow block bodies + object literal method bodies taken over by possible)
stage4o.description: Arrow block bodies (single param, parameter list, async, nested if, expression statement at root, inside a block, nested block body, as a call argument, empty, no trailing semicolon), object literal method bodies (method, two members, get/set accessors, async method, return-typed method, inside a block, nested block body, method in a call argument), and the trap group (type literal, object literal without methods, plain arrow expression body, control-flow body, label body, switch case block, class method body).

cases.name: s4o-arrow-single
cases.source: const f = x => { let y = 1; return y; };

cases.name: s4o-arrow-async
cases.source: const f = async x => { await g(); };

cases.name: s4o-obj-accessors
cases.source: const o = { get x(){ let y = 1; return y; }, set x(v){ let z = v; } };

cases.name: s4o-obj-async
cases.source: const o = { async m(){ await g(); } };

cases.name: s4o-obj-return-type
cases.source: const o = { m(): number { let y = 2; return y; } };

cases.name: s4o-trap-return-object
cases.source: function f(){ return { m(){ let y = 2; } }; }
